name: crop_leaf_diseases_vit (ONNX export of a ViT-tiny-patch16-224 crop-leaf classifier)
license_notes: The base model card body states 'License: Apache 2.0' (the KisanOS task assignment cites the same). The Hugging Face repository metadata for BOTH the base and the ONNX repo is tagged 'license: mit'. The conflict exists upstream and is recorded here as-is; KisanOS does not resolve it. Both are permissive licenses.
source_status_notes: Artifact provenance is pinned below (commit + SHA-256). The publisher's reported evaluation (98% accuracy) has NOT been validated by KisanOS on local field photos; all outputs are treated as uncalibrated visible-sign evidence only.
architecture: ViTForImageClassification (ViT-tiny-patch16-224): 12 layers, hidden size 192, 3 attention heads, patch size 16, 5,526,925 parameters, 13 output classes

format.quantization: NOT quantized: the file is full float32 (22,301,835 bytes ~= 5,526,925 params x 4 bytes) and contains no QuantizeLinear/DequantizeLinear ops. The ONNX repo is titled as a quantized model and its README lists a crop_leaf_diseases_vit.quant.onnx INT8 file, but that file is not present in the repository; the only model file is the pre-quantization original, as the README's own file list says. Recorded as observed on 2026-10-04.

mapping_rules: Only wheat classes map to KisanOS visible-sign classes (label_map.json). Every other model output (Corn/Potato/Rice/Invalid) is treated as 'not_wheat' and the Vision gateway abstains. Outputs describe visible signs only, never a diagnosis, cause, or treatment.
usage_scope: KisanOS Vision Agent local inference for wheat leaf photos only; outputs feed visible findings that flow to the Crop Agent and Farm Advisor as uncalibrated image evidence.
